description: Every page of a site's latest read, one of three ways. tree: by address, folders as branches, each page with its state, failing rules, clicks from home and words. links: each page reached from home with its clicks and its first way in, the hubs, and the pages no link leads to (none named when the read stopped at its page limit). meaning: each page placed from 0 to 1 across and down by what it is about, in groups, with its nearest pages; close means similar in meaning, never better or cited.

site.description: The site, as a domain such as example.com.

title: Map a site
